bollinger_la_zscore_doi_ten.ghi_chu: 12/09 - vi sao `bollinger` 0 lan dung trong kho 891 co che: bo doc KHONG bo sot no, no DICH thanh zscore. 'Go long when price closes above the 20-period Bollinger upper band' -> zscore(close,20) > 2,0. Dung ve toan hoc (close > sma+k*sd <=> zscore > k) nen 0 lan la DUNG, khong phai lo hong. Cai THAT SU khong noi duoc la `lay='do_rong'` (bandwidth/squeeze) va `lay='phan_tram_b'` (%B) - hai cai do khong quy ve mot phep so sanh zscore duoc.

ba_hinh_dang_cau_bi_tu_choi.ghi_chu: 12/09 - do tren 6 cau luat Bollinger that: nut that cua 1A KHONG phai tu vung ma la HINH DANG CAU. Ba ly do tu choi gap ngay trong mau nho: (1) 'cau ta ca chieu mua lan chieu ban' - ma 'buy when X, sell when Y' la cach nguoi ta phat bieu luat PHO BIEN NHAT, va ngu phap noi duoc: do la HAI khai bao chieu +1 va -1, khong phai mot; (2) "cau co 'or' giua hai so sanh - ngu phap chi co VA"; (3) 'cau mo ta hai kha nang cung luc'. Dang do so cau tung ly do chan bang _ly_do_tu_choi.py.
